recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochrome composition featuring four men in coordinated dark, reflective clothing posed dynamically against a stark white floor and a dark-to-light gradient background, topped with large, outlined metallic numerals.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouettes against a high-key floor
Metallic typography overlapping the dark upper gradient
Rhythmic repetition of figures in dynamic, low-center-of-gravity poses
Reflective textures on clothing mirroring the metallic finish of the text
coreInvariants: Large-scale numeric display at the top
Reflective satin or leather clothing textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged in a staggered horizontal line from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large '4.0' numeric display at the top center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large numbers, moves down to the rhythmic poses of the group, and follows the diagonal lines created by their limbs across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the bottom and a dark gradient void at the top create a compressed stage effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for clothing and upper gradient
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the floor and lower background
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver/grey for typographic outlines and highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the subjects and the floor.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are rendered as thin outlines with a subtle metallic gradient fill
The decimal point is a perfect circle positioned centrally between the base of the numbers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single high-impact display face used for branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif structure and elegant 90s R&B aesthetic.
Provides the necessary vertical stress and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A monochrome photo of four men in black satin jackets and sunglasses, posed in dynamic crouching and lunging positions on a white floor. The background is a vertical gradient from black at the top to white at the bottom. High contrast, sharp focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large '4.0' text in the top center using a thin-outline Didone font with a metallic silver gradient fill and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Do the numbers have a high-contrast serif structure?
Is the floor pure white with sharp shadows?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the metallic sheen on text
Specific poses of the four subjects
mustRedesign: Any specific faces or recognizable brand logos
Exact text content from the original
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered and large.
Check that the gradient transition is smooth.
Verify the high-key lighting on the floor.
Confirm the metallic outline effect on the numbers.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast monochrome photography of a group in reflective streetwear with oversized, metallic-outline Didone typography set against a dark-to-light vertical gradient.
